memoryPolicy: Extraction sends only the selected completed user/assistant turn after explicit preflight. Candidates remain transient until explicit confirmation. Stored extracted memories retain bounded provenance; deletion requires detach-or-delete choice. Requests freeze role, space, source and model configuration.
limitations: Static APK entry scan in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE. Device database, WAL, cache, Keystore files, SQLCipher upgrade, UI interaction and live provider requests require a connected device or controlled endpoint.
